tagline: World's 6th Largest Reinsurer with Global Reach
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross written premiums of €16.1 billion consolidate SCOR's position among the global leaders in reinsurance. This metric reflects the group's ability to serve approximately 5,000 clients and generate stable growth across its balanced P&C and L&H operations.

kpis.name: Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of insurance premiums collected by SCOR in 2024.
kpis.description: SCOR generated €16.126 billion in insurance revenue in 2024, down 1.3% from €15.922 billion in 2023, consolidating its position among the global leaders in reinsurance.
kpis.signal: High revenue reflecting a strong global position as the 6th largest reinsurer.

kpis.name: Gross Written Premiums
kpis.explanation: Total volume of gross premiums written by SCOR before ceded reinsurance.
kpis.description: SCOR wrote €20.064 billion in gross premiums in 2024, up 3.6% from €19.371 billion in 2023, demonstrating the group's resilience and growth capacity in its reinsurance operations.
kpis.signal: Growth in gross premiums reflecting strong demand in a favorable market environment.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees within the SCOR Group.
kpis.description: SCOR employs 3,621 people worldwide, supporting its global reinsurance operations and investment activities.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce, consistent with a risk management model that is expertise-intensive.

kpis.name: Number of Clients
kpis.explanation: Total number of insurance and reinsurance clients served globally.
kpis.description: SCOR serves approximately 5,000 clients worldwide, primarily insurers seeking to pool their risks through the group's P&C and L&H reinsurance platforms.
kpis.signal: Large client base reflecting broad geographic and sectoral coverage in reinsurance.

kpis.name: Net Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Insurance revenue net of claims and operating expenses.
kpis.description: SCOR reported €12.661 billion in net insurance revenue in 2024, down 3.1% from €13.068 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: Net revenue reflecting operational profitability after claims exposure.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €36.1 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.57 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €1.84 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Increased competition in reinsurance markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in section 3.1 as a key factor, with strong language on competitive pressure. It is recurring and its severity is amplified by SCOR's strategic position. High weight in the Competition category.

risks.title: Regulatory changes impacting solvency
risks.score_rationale: Listed at the top of strategic risks, mentioned with strong language ("major issue"). Trend toward persistent regulatory complexity. High weight in governance and compliance.

risks.title: Dependence on distribution partners
risks.score_rationale: Identified in operational risks, with language emphasizing strategic dependence. Stable trend. Significant weight due to impact on market access.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in operational risks with concerned language. Trend of increasing cyber threats. High weight due to sensitivity of customer data and reliance on digital systems.

risks.title: Management of actuarial assumptions in health
risks.score_rationale: Central risk in 2024, with direct financial impact (€700M loss). Very strong language on assumption revisions. Trend toward instability. High weight in L&H.

risks.title: Dependence on technology providers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in operational risks, moderate language. Stable trend. Medium weight due to growing criticality of data platforms.

risks.title: Energy transition and climate risks
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly cited, with strong language on climate change impact. Trend toward worsening conditions. High weight due to exposure to natural catastrophes.

risks.title: Geopolitical and regional instabilities
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in operational risks with concrete examples (riots in New Caledonia). Factual but concerned language. Trend upward. Significant weight for man-made risks.
